description: Primary database for sensor logging, irrigation events, controller health, and internal system tracking.

tables.description: Live time-series readings from all field sensors, including soil moisture, temperature, and rain gauges.

columns.station_id: ID of the station where the sensor is located.
columns.sensor_type: Type of sensor (e.g., moisture, temp, rain_gauge).
columns.unit: Unit of the sensor reading, e.g., %, °C.
columns.received_at: Timestamp when the data was received.
columns.location_id: Mapped location ID from the locations table.

example_queries: Show the latest soil moisture value.
What was the last rainfall amount?
Get all temperature readings from the past 6 hours.
What value did the controller see for moisture yesterday?

tables.description: Event log of control decisions including manual and automated irrigation commands.

columns.station: The station where the control event was issued.
columns.sensor_id: Sensor used to trigger the action.
columns.command: Type of action taken (e.g., open_valve, start_irrigation).
columns.value: Optional numeric value associated with command.
columns.duration: How long the action lasted (in seconds).

example_queries: When was the last watering in zone 2?
What command was issued for the tomatoes yesterday?
Show the last time any valve opened.
How long was the sprinkler on?
